mcq_fix.s: According to Census 2001, which State had the largest number of towns?

mcq_drop.why: oddly worded ('2001 position referred to in the data'); obscure

pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: national highways; suspect key: old NH-1 = Delhi-Amritsar (Delhi-Kolkata was NH-2)
wrong topic: AP districts by area
wrong topic: AP capital / current affairs
suspect key: Lutyens designed New Delhi (option 2), not Chandigarh

patterns: APPSC asks city population ranking as 'arrange in decreasing order' (2001 order: Kolkata, Delhi, Bangalore, Ahmedabad, Kanpur); note that Delhi overtook Kolkata in 2011.
Planned cities and their architects: Le Corbusier for Chandigarh, Lutyens for New Delhi; 'not a planned capital' (Bengaluru).
Odd-one-out scheme questions: Rurban is not an urban-rejuvenation programme.
AP tilt: least urbanised southern State, million-plus UAs (Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada), AP district and capital facts.
The app adds many Census 2011 statement sets and 2025-26 policy figures (16th FC, ES 2025-26, World Cities Report), deeper than the PYQs.
